final:
{"prompt": "A square, full-bleed abstract expressionist painting in oil and cold wax on heavy canvas, nonrepresentational throughout, with the paint covering the whole image to every edge. No frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text.

The left two-thirds is dense and turbulent. Many translucent layers of ultramarine, blue-black, and burnt umber are dragged, scraped, and re-scraped with a wide squeegee and stiff bristle brushes. Cracked, buttery impasto ridges sit over thin glazes, and the older layers show through the scraped gaps like sediment. Hurried, overlapping gestural strokes pull in competing directions, some confident and sweeping, some stuttering and doubled back on themselves.

A narrow, jagged fracture of saturated cadmium orange and hot vermilion cuts diagonally through this mass. It is applied in one fast, loaded palette-knife pull, with raw bright paint crowding the edges of the cut. Small flecks and drips of the same orange scatter into the darkness and fade out.

The right third opens into a large area of quiet, nearly empty space in pale bone white and chalky grey-green. It has only faint ghosted veils of translucent paint, soft finger-smudged tonal shifts, and a few thin, hesitant strokes of cool teal that trail away. The surface here is matte and thin, so the canvas weave shows. The contrast between the crowded, dark, heavily worked side and the pale, open side creates strong spatial tension, as if pressure is slowly releasing without fully resolving.

The rhythm alternates between heavy, congested passages and sudden breaths of emptiness. The palette is limited and deliberate: deep ultramarine, blue-black, umber, a single hot orange, bone white, and a trace of teal. Lighting is flat and even, as in a studio photograph of the painting, with the texture, drips, scraped edges, and layered paint clearly legible. The mood is intense, restless, searching, and unfinished, with a thread of tenderness in the quiet area."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
